title: International Foundation Diploma In Logistics and Supply Chain Management (Level 3)
description: This qualification introduces learners to the fundamental principles of logistics, supply chain management, procurement, inventory control, and transportation.
longDescription: The International Foundation Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Management (Level 3) provides learners with a foundational understanding of logistics and supply chain operations. It explores procurement, inventory management, transportation, warehousing, and the movement of goods. Learners develop essential communication, problem-solving, organisational, and analytical skills relevant to logistics environments. The qualification prepares learners for entry-level roles, further study, and progression in logistics and supply chain management. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 60 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: Explain the fundamental principles and functions of logistics and supply chain management. Describe the key stages of procurement and purchasing processes within organisations. Identify basic inventory management techniques and warehousing operations. Explain transportation methods, distribution systems, and their role in supply chain efficiency. Apply basic problem-solving and communication skills to common logistics and supply chain scenarios. Recognise the importance of customer service, sustainability, and technology in modern supply chain operations. entry: Endorsed Diploma In Accountancy (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.

accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the Endorsed Diploma In Logistics and Supply Chain Management (Level-3) students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
